description: Data encoding and expressive power of variational quantum models (Schuld, Sweke, Meyer 2021)

arguments.help: Override the number of optimizer steps of a fitting experiment (fit.training.steps)
Override the Adam learning rate of a fitting experiment (fit.training.lr)
Override the mini-batch size of a fitting experiment (fit.training.batch_size)
Comma-separated seeds of a fitting experiment, e.g. 0,1,2 (fit.seeds)
true: every optimizer step uses the whole grid (Phase 4 amendment protocols P1-P3); false: the paper's mini-batches (fit.training.full_batch)
adam (paper), adam_cosine (Phase 5 protocol P4) or lbfgs (P5, needs --full-batch true) (fit.training.optimizer)
